sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday))) as current_age FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 GROUP BY p.player_api_id
